svg.title: JUNO data-transfer sites in Europe and Asia
svg.desc: The JUNO Experiment Site in Jiangmen sends raw data to IHEP in Beijing. IHEP, JINR in Dubna, CC-IN2P3 in Lyon and CNAF in Bologna have six bidirectional FTS connections.
svg.metadata: {"projection":"Mercator","bounds":[-12,15,132,70],"locations":"Approximate city/region anchors, not surveyed facility coordinates","nodes":[{"id":"Jiangmen","name":"JUNO Experiment Site","location":[113.08,22.58],"label":[500,404],"subtitle":"Jiangmen","anchor":"start","position":[638.0277777777778,373.85741864931384]},{"id":"IHEP","location":[116.4,39.9],"label":[658,244],"subtitle":"Beijing","anchor":"start","position":[654.1666666666667,281.88634732938334]},{"id":"JINR","location":[37.17,56.74],"label":[277,112],"subtitle":"Dubna","anchor":"start","position":[269.02083333333337,166.18939656111573]},{"id":"CC-IN2P3","location":[4.84,45.76],"label":[25,204],"subtitle":"Lyon","anchor":"start","position":[111.86111111111111,245.8067272814164]},{"id":"CNAF","location":[11.34,44.49],"label":[147,310],"subtitle":"Bologna","anchor":"start","position":[143.45833333333331,253.92510968192568]}],"edges":[{"from":"Jiangmen","to":"IHEP","kind":"raw","control":[721,335]},{"from":"IHEP","to":"JINR","kind":"fts","control":[510,95]},{"from":"IHEP","to":"CC-IN2P3","kind":"fts","control":[375,151]},{"from":"IHEP","to":"CNAF","kind":"fts","control":[390,365]},{"from":"JINR","to":"CC-IN2P3","kind":"fts","control":[128,145]},{"from":"JINR","to":"CNAF","kind":"fts","control":[280,280]},{"from":"CC-IN2P3","to":"CNAF","kind":"fts","control":[91,321]}],"source":"Natural Earth 1:110m land"}
